+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+
+
+def fetch_recent_logs(
+    field_filters: Dict[str, Any],
+    start_time: str,
+    end_time: str,
+    limit: int = 100,
+) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

+    base_url = os.environ.get("SPLUNK_SEARCH_API_URL", "https://api.splunk.com")

+        raise RuntimeError("SPLUNK_HEC_TOKEN is required")
+

+    query = " AND ".join(query_parts) if query_parts else "*"
+    payload = {

+        "output_mode": "json",
+    }

+

+

+

+    parser.add_argument("--start-time", required=True)

+import argparse
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+LOKI_QUERY_RANGE_URL = "https://logs-prod-us.grafana.net/loki/api/v1/query_range"
+
+
+def parse_time(value):
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if value.endswith("Z"):
+        value = value[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt
+
+
+def to_ns(dt):
+    return int(dt.timestamp() * 1_000_000_000)
+
+
+def build_query(severity):
+    return f'{{severity="{severity}"}}'
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--severity", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--start", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--end", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=100)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    username = os.environ.get("GRAFANA_CLOUD_LOGS_USERNAME")
+    token = os.environ.get("GRAFANA_CLOUD_API_KEY")
+    if not username or not token:
+        raise SystemExit("GRAFANA_CLOUD_LOGS_USERNAME and GRAFANA_CLOUD_API_KEY are required")
+
+    start_dt = parse_time(args.start)
+    end_dt = parse_time(args.end)
+    params = {
+        "query": build_query(args.severity),
+        "start": to_ns(start_dt),
+        "end": to_ns(end_dt),
+        "limit": args.limit,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.get(
+        LOKI_QUERY_RANGE_URL,
+        params=params,
+        auth=(username, token),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    for stream in data.get("data", {}).get("result", []):
+        labels = stream.get("stream", {})
+        for ts, line in stream.get("values", []):
+            print(f"{ts} {labels} {line}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+import uuid
+
+import requests
+
+
+NEW_RELIC_INGEST_URL = "https://log-api.newrelic.com/log/v1"
+
+
+def build_events(correlation_id: str):
+    now = int(time.time() * 1000)
+    return [
+        {
+            "timestamp": now,
+            "message": "request started",
+            "level": "INFO",
+            "service.name": os.getenv("SERVICE_NAME", "example-app"),
+            "request.id": correlation_id,
+            "correlation.id": correlation_id,
+        },
+        {
+            "timestamp": now + 10,
+            "message": "request completed",
+            "level": "INFO",
+            "service.name": os.getenv("SERVICE_NAME", "example-app"),
+            "request.id": correlation_id,
+            "correlation.id": correlation_id,
+        },
+    ]
+
+
+def send_logs(events):
+    license_key = os.getenv("NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY")
+    if not license_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY is required")
+    headers = {
+        "Api-Key": license_key,
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(NEW_RELIC_INGEST_URL, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(events), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+
+
+def main():
+    correlation_id = os.getenv("CORRELATION_ID", str(uuid.uuid4()))
+    events = build_events(correlation_id)
+    send_logs(events)
+    sys.stdout.write(correlation_id + "\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
